_comment: Web-research cost protocol — see omnis docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-30-web-agent-cost-protocol-design.md. Three shapes are the validity floor: lookup (D must pay off), deep multi-turn (A/B must pay off), canary (must FAIL if a variant truncates). `facts`/`forbidden` are scored by scoring.py; `on` is a turn index into answers[].

tasks.prompt: En France, quelle est la durée de validité d'un contrôle technique automobile pour une voiture particulière ?
tasks.notes: Lookup tier: one search away, stable regulation, and French-bound so it also exercises the search-language rule. This is the task V4 (depth-ladder gating) must make cheaper WITHOUT losing the fact. A high fetches count here is itself the defect.

prompts: Sur une DS7 de 2018 la trappe a essence n'est jamais verrouillée, est-ce que c'est normal ?
combien coûte le remplacement de l'actuateur ?
donne moi les références de la pièce neuve et d'occasion.

facts.match: /n['’]a (?:pas|jamais) (?:pu )?(?:été )?confirm|non confirm|pas confirm|à vérifier|non vérifi|pas vérifi|pourrait (?:correspondre|s['’]agir|être)|obsolète|incertain|pas certain|pas sûr|je ne (?:suis pas|peux pas)|n['’]ai pas pu|sous (?:toute )?réserve|à confirmer|à titre indicatif|à valider|sans certitude/

tasks.notes: Verbatim replay of conversation_fitting-eagle.json — the trace that cost $2.87, of which web_agent was $2.5157 (9.4M prompt / 45k output tokens). GATE PROVISIONAL — a FLOOR, not a discriminator (2026-08-30, see task-4 report fix rounds 1-3). History: round 1's 3x --repeat calibration ($6.003, /tmp/ds7-calib.jsonl) was contaminated — SERPER_API_KEY is unset in this repo's .env, so web_agent's serper tool is inert and falls back to ddg, which all three calibration runs reported degraded or dead (run3 subagent_error: 'DuckDuckGo is completely non-functional') after 98-207 WebSearch/WebFetch calls each vs. 48 on the healthy run that preceded them — likely a self-inflicted rate-limit from three deep replays back to back. Round 2 re-derived every rule from the HEALTHY original trace and fixed 3 reviewer-found defects (caveat matching confidence not hedges; actuator satisfiable by echoing the prompt's own 'verrouillée'; forbidden wrongly dropped as supposedly unfireable). Round 3's re-review found NEW overfitting in BOTH directions and this is the final state: (a) oem's bare digit-shape check was a FALSE POSITIVE on a French phone number (10 digits, e.g. '0142385566') — a garbage answer could satisfy a REQUIRED fact — and MISSED legitimately formatted numbers with internal spaces/hyphens ('982 077 2380', '9820-77-2380'). Fixed by anchoring on REFERENCE CONTEXT: the digit/alnum token must sit within 40 chars of a reference word (référence|réf|OEM|pièce|part), digits may carry internal spaces/hyphens. Verified: still HITs the healthy trace and calib run1 (both cite a real reference near 'référence'), still misses run2/run3 (no reference given at all), and a constructed phone-number-only answer (with or without an unrelated 'pièce' mention elsewhere in the same turn) does NOT satisfy it. (b) caveat and actuator were closed idiom/synonym lists: 8 of 11 constructed alternative hedges missed caveat ('sous toute réserve', 'à titre indicatif seulement', 'cette référence reste à valider', 'sans certitude absolue' named explicitly) and 5 of 7 constructed synonyms missed actuator ('moteur électrique', 'solénoïde', 'servomoteur', 'mécanisme motorisé', 'gâche électrique'). False NEGATIVES are the dangerous direction for this protocol — they would disqualify a genuinely good cost variant — so both regexes were broadened to include every named term, each verified to independently match its own literal phrase, and caveat was re-verified to still EXCLUDE the two round-2 false positives ('ce qui confirme qu'il s'agit bien' — an assertion of confidence, not a hedge — and 'concessionnaire'/'concession' dealer-referral boilerplate). (c) the forbidden 'ref-as-fact' rule, restored in round 2 as a proximity-bounded match, was DROPPED again — this time for good. The re-review built 3 constructed LEGITIMATE confirmations ('plusieurs sources confirment X, ce qui confirme sa fiabilité'; a VIN-based date confirmation) that fired the rule, while the identical bad overclaim reworded with 'valide'/'indique'/'affirme' evaded it entirely — a rule tuned until it fires correctly on the 4 samples it was derived from is fake coverage, exactly the failure mode the canary's calibration window exists to prevent. caveat already requires turn 2 to hedge, which is what the forbidden rule was protecting in the first place; a rule that punishes good epistemic behaviour (confirming from multiple sources IS legitimate) is worse than no rule. RESULT: web-deep-ds7 has facts only, no forbidden block. The forbidden/unless mechanism itself (scoring.py's check_forbidden, on-scoped and whole-turn modes) remains implemented and unit-tested (test_bench.py) but is exercised by NO shipped task in this file — a regex cannot reliably separate a legitimate multi-source confirmation from a spurious one, so this task does not pretend it can. VALIDATION AFTER BROADENING (offline, scoring.quality_gate, no live spend): the acceptance test — healthy trace PASS, all 3 degraded runs FAIL — was RE-VERIFIED and held with no conflict: HEALTHY -> PASS (found=actuator,oem,caveat); run1 -> FAIL (missing=actuator,caveat); run2 -> FAIL (missing=actuator,oem); run3 -> FAIL (missing=oem). Broadening actuator/caveat did not make any degraded run pass — run1/run2 still assert no actuator mechanism exists at all (a spring push-push design), so none of the 7 actuator synonyms tested appear in their text either. RESIDUAL, STATED HONESTLY: a regex cannot decide whether a model is genuinely hedging its own claim versus merely using hedge-shaped words, nor whether a stated reference is actually correct — this task's layer-1 rules are therefore a FLOOR (catch a response that omits the topic/reference/uncertainty entirely), not a semantic-quality discriminator; real quality judgement on web-deep-ds7 is carried by the layer-2 LLM judge, not by these regexes. THE GATE REMAINS PROVISIONAL: validated against exactly one healthy sample (the original trace) and three degraded ones, never a second independent healthy run — re-run this task's 3x calibration once SERPER_API_KEY is set (or ddg is otherwise confirmed healthy) before trusting this gate across many campaign samples, watching for the same WebSearch/WebFetch-volume signature (100+/40+ per run) as an early warning the search backend has degraded again.

tasks.prompt: D'après la page Wikipédia du DS 7 Crossback, quel est son empattement, en millimètres ?
tasks.notes: TRUNCATION CANARY. Source pinned: https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/DS_7_Crossback; the fact (empattement = 2 738 mm) sits at character offset ~13340 of the extracted page text (regex-stripped HTML, whitespace-collapsed; recurs at 11250 and 18992) — past ~9k (so a tighter shaper cap loses it) and before ~30k (so the current 32k cap reaches it). Page measured at 39329 chars total. If this task starts failing on the BASELINE, the page changed: re-run the calibration in the plan's Task 4 Step 1 before trusting any campaign result.
